changelog: SPAM-1 tightened: 2 or more links now count as spam (v1 said 3). HAR-1 widened: mocking a person's appearance is now named explicitly. New clause IMP-1: impersonating another user.

clauses.title: Targeted harassment
clauses.text: Content that insults, demeans or mocks a specific identifiable person, including mocking their appearance, is not allowed.

clauses.title: Threats of violence
clauses.text: Content that threatens, encourages or celebrates physical harm against a person or group is not allowed.

violating: I will hurt you if I see you again
allowed: This workout is going to kill me

clauses.title: Hate speech against protected groups
clauses.text: Content that attacks or dehumanises people based on a protected characteristic such as race, ethnicity, religion, disability, gender or sexual orientation is not allowed.

violating: People of that religion are vermin
allowed: I disagree with that religion's teachings

clauses.title: Self-harm content
clauses.text: Content that encourages or gives instructions for self-harm is not allowed. Personal disclosures of distress are reviewed by a person so the author can be offered support.

violating: Here is how to hurt yourself without anyone noticing
allowed: Talking to a counsellor helped me a lot

clauses.title: Sharing private personal information
clauses.text: Posting someone's private contact details, such as an email address or phone number, is not allowed.

violating: Call Jordan at 555-123-4567 and tell them what you think
allowed: Contact the support team through the help page

clauses.title: Spam and unsolicited promotion
clauses.text: Repetitive posting or unsolicited promotion, including posts with 2 or more links, is not allowed.

clauses.title: Impersonation
clauses.text: Pretending to be another user, a moderator or an official account in a way that could mislead people is not allowed.

violating: I am the real @sam, ignore the other account
allowed: I am a big fan of @sam
